title: Quantum Non-Gaussian State Preparation of Levitated Particles via Time-Dependent Control of Weakly Nonharmonic Hybrid Potentials
summary: Levitated high-mass quantum systems provide access to unprecedented regimes in both fundamental science and technological applications. However, deterministic generation and manipulation of quantum non-Gaussian states, which are central to many continuous-variable quantum advantages, remain elusive in such platforms. In this work, we propose a theoretical protocol for preparing a continuous-variable degree of freedom of a levitated massive object in a variety of quantum states, including Fock and Schrödinger cat states, without coupling to auxiliary two-level systems.
